ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected surah.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: Respect? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on: Respect has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: Respect.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on: Respect to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of care for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use care for plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say care for plants has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing care for plants.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Environment to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Environment has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. Which response best shows understanding of Believe in? (1 mark)
   A. Say Believe in has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Believe in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Believe in.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick.
   C. Say Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Honesty.
   C. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on: responsibility to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on: responsibility has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: responsibility.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain care for plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. C — Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of care for plants; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
